claims.claim: Intel Q2 2026 revenue rose 25% YoY to $16.1B; Data Center and AI revenue rose 59% and Intel Foundry revenue rose 31%.
Intel 18A-P entered risk production, selected 18A products entered high-volume manufacturing using High-NA EUV, and management is increasing capacity investment to support AI/product/foundry demand.

risks.risk: Foundry remains loss-making and leading-edge ramp economics are exposed to yield, utilization and capital-intensity risk.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong revenue growth coexists with a large GAAP net loss, requiring normalization of restructuring/one-time effects and foundry economics.

unknowns.unknown: External foundry customer economics and durable 18A utilization are not established here.

claims.claim: Operational execution improved materially: revenue growth accelerated, gross margin recovered and factory yields/cycle times improved, while 18A milestones advanced.
The decisive expectation test remains profitable foundry conversion: current evidence shows improving operations but foundry losses and high capital needs prevent treating the turnaround as complete.

risks.risk: Execution can regress if 18A yield/utilization or external foundry demand disappoints.

contradictions.contradiction: Headline growth is stronger than bottom-line GAAP profitability, so turnaround evidence must remain two-sided.

unknowns.unknown: Current market valuation and normalized foundry return profile remain for underwriting.
